entries.title: Psalms 28:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, [if] thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit. {to me: Heb. from me}

words.text: to me: lest, [if] thou be silent

entries.title: Psalms 28:2
segments: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle. {thy...: or, the oracle of thy sanctuary}

words.text: unto thee, when I lift up
. {thy...: or, the oracle of thy sanctuary}

entries.title: Psalms 28:3
segments: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief [is] in their hearts.

entries.title: Psalms 28:4
segments: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

entries.title: Psalms 28:5
segments: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

words.text: them, and not build them up

entries.title: Psalms 28:6
segments: ¶Blessed [be] the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 28:7
segments: The LORD [is] my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

words.text: in him, and I am helped

entries.title: Psalms 28:8
segments: The LORD [is] their strength, and he [is] the saving strength of his anointed. {their: or, his} {saving...: Heb. strength of salvations}

words.text: . {their: or, his} {saving...: Heb. strength of salvations}

entries.title: Psalms 28:9
segments: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever. {feed: or, rule}

words.text: them also, and lift them up
